document: Eco Mode Menu Design and User Choice in LLM Services

source.source_read: Fresh complete Library read, 347 lines, 10 pages, no remaining text

adaptation: Rewritten in English for outside academic readers, with research overview, rationale, questions, menu conditions, procedure, outcomes, analysis, feasibility, ethics, contribution and scope.
Retains Korean-speaking adult LLM users as initial study population; English examples are illustrative translations. English-language replication requires linguistic validation.
Three authored task-response pairs and participant guidance retained in appendices. Common response evaluation explicitly independent of mode execution.
Korean v4 preserved as a separate Library item and GitHub source; manuscript v0.6 unchanged.

menus.A: Light / Medium / High / Extra High / Max
menus.B: Eco / Light / Medium / High / Extra High / Max

scope.primary: First-task Eco selection proportion difference, compact minus coexistence, with 95% CI
scope.interpretation: Whole-menu package effect; not independent Eco-word effect
scope.function: Adaptive conservation-oriented Eco policy versus fixed low Light; proposed concept only
scope.acceptance: Unchanged use separated from personal editing; adequate brevity separated from explicit perceived shortcoming acceptance
scope.sample: 6–10 formative participants and 20–30 minute sessions proposed; main N and costs to be fixed before recruitment
scope.environment: No measured resource or environmental savings, no evidence of development slowdown; quality preservation and physical savings are not first-study success gates
